# Experiment summary (auto-generated by scripts/make_plots.py)

Values are mean ± 95% confidence half-width over seeded randomised trials (start pose and obstacle layout differ per seed). Success = docked with true position error < 5 cm and yaw error < 10 deg. 'True path error' is the distance of the TRUE robot from the active path; 'LQR cross-track on estimate' is the error the controller sees (estimate vs path). NEES for a consistent 3-state filter averages 3 and lies under 7.81 for 95% of steps.
